---
name: Game test result
about: You tested a mechanic in game (see docs/unknowns-and-assumptions.md)
labels: game data
---

**What you tested**
Which entry in [unknowns and assumptions](https://github.com/sinisterbot7900/ck-dps-solver/blob/main/docs/unknowns-and-assumptions.md), or another mechanic.

**How**
Your setup (items, talents, buffs) and what you did, e.g. "counted Bat minion hits on a training dummy for 20 seconds".

**What you saw**
The numbers, with screenshots if you have them (character screen, tooltips, damage numbers).

**Game version**
Shown on the title screen.
